sentence: Elsewhere, a cursed womb begins to nurse a special grade curse.
Mai and Maki argue over which of them is lower class than the other, but Maki believes they're both at the bottom.
The jujutsu sorcerers want to get the fighting over quickly, but the curse users have a few tricks of their own.
The reason for Yuji's accelerated growth as a sorcerer is...!
Yuji quickly loses the upper hand while Nobara uses Mahito's overconfidence against him.
In order to save his friends, Yuji teams up with jujutsu student, Megumi Fushiguro, to exorcise the curses and recover the cursed object: Ryomen Sukuna.
The escort team nearly completes their mission until the former member of the Zenin Clan changes everything.
As the battle presses on, Kashimo shows he's willing to take risks in order to achieve victory as well.
Before Megumi's able to ask for help, Hakari's conflict with Yuji reaches its climax.
She resents Maki for leaving the Zenin Clan and feels the pressure of living up to be better than her.
Regardless of being separated, Yuji and Megumi work finding on Hiromi Higuruma.
The Evening Festival reaches its conclusion and the promised day in Shibuya finally arrives.
Yuji has no desire to help the jujutsu sorcerers defeat Dabura but agrees to handle the cursed spirits fleeing Tokyo.
Those who were already inside a barrier colony when the Culling Game began on November 1st were given one chance to escape.
Thanks to Aoi's simple and effective cursed technique, he and Yuji are able to gain the upper hand on Hanami.
That being said, the strongest jujutsu sorcerer doesn't go down so easily.
Mastering this move will allow Yuji to grow stronger than ever before!
With Yuji and Choso both having been dealt with, Yuta offers Naoya a deal he can't refuse.
When faced with the life of another in her hands, Nobara looks back to her past.
Hakari is surprised by what occurred in Shibuya and agrees to help, but only on the condition that they return the favor in the future.
To ensure the safety of the Star Plasma Vessel, Satoru unleashes the powers of his Limitless technique.
Meanwhile, the culprit, Mahito, and the only known witness, Junpei discuss the origin of curses.
At the same time, Suguru begins to fall into self isolation, constantly questioning his morals when it comes to non-sorcerers.
The Shibuya Incident begins!
Kasumi Miwa learns that the rank does not reflect the strength of the sorcerer when it comes to Maki Zenin.
Meanwhile, Choso, Mahito, and Pseudo-Geto gain wind of the incident.
However, before he can avenge his brothers, Choso's mind is invaded by a memory of something that never happened.
Suguru has made his decision to reject non-sorcerers.
Kashimo enjoys the challenge and decides to try and defeat someone who's effectively immortal.
The cursed spirit desperately tries to take Todo out of the equation so he can focus on killing Yuji.
The fight will ultimately be decided if Unlimited Hollow carves its way through Shinjuku again.
Powerful, smart, and misunderstood, Aoi was bored with the world in his youth.
They agree to get stronger for Yuji, but is he truly gone?
With that gratitude lifting any uncertainty from his soul to this day, Nanami is ready to die with no regrets...
Meanwhile, Megumi deduces the nature of Jiro Awasaka's technique and devises a counter-attack.
Before Yuji can get a word in, communications suddenly break down when Kirara is able to get a warning to Hakari.
Can the earthling sorcerers coexist with their alien visitors?
At the same time, Kasumi learns about Maki's true power.
Megumi and Nobara focus on improving their weaknesses with Maki, while Gojo sensei hopes that he can improve on Yuji's strengths.
Kashimo not only seeks to defeat Sukuna, but to learn what it truly means to be the strongest.
Megumi and Panda want to convince Kirara they're not enemies so that negotiations with Hakari go smoothly.
Before he can finish them off for good, Jogo notices Sukuna's presence in Shibuya.
Instead, Yuji finds himself on trial against the lawyer and the judgement may be fatal!
Just when Mahito believes he's won, the former salaryman gets serious when he begins working overtime.
But is Panda... truly a Panda?
Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.
They are two incarnations without an outlet for their passions because Japanese culture has left them in the past.
Mifuyu Okkotsu reprimands her children for their reckless behavior, but expresses her pride in giving birth to them.
While Satoru Gojo can use reverse cursed technique to survive, his allies watching the fight know this situation doesn't fair well for even the strongest.
Yuji reveals Eso and Kechizu's last words to Choso, surfacing the fury of the proud elder brother.
Yuji regains control over his body only to witness the aftermath of all the destruction from Sukuna's merciless rampage.
Takako Uro makes her move and unleashes a technique that controls the sky.
They decide to spend the rest of their time relaxing while waiting out the time limit of the bounty.
However, Kirara refuses to believe Megumi and Panda aren't spies for Jujutsu High, and resists them.
Despite the triumph, there are still trials and tribulations for the jujutsu sorcerers overcome.
Now he wishes to draw Kinji Hakari's blood as well as manga.
However, Yuji's struggle has breathed new life into his friend, who is ready to return the favor and stand against the King of Curses!
Following a tragic sacrifice, Yuji resonates with yet another brother to open a path to victory!
